title: Deutsche Telekom and SphereNet Is Helping Build Payment Rails for AI Agents
excerpt: Deutsche Telekom will operate a SphereNet validator as Sphere Labs develops a compliance-focused ledger for regulated finance and agentic payments.
content_html:
Giving AI the ability to spend your money – are we already there? An AI agent can now book a flight, renew software, or purchase computing power for a business. The next step is allowing that agent to complete the payment on its own.

That shift is already underway. Coinbase's x402 protocol has processed 109.6 million transactions and around $15 million in adjusted volume since May 2025. 

Most were tiny payments, but on a larger scale, this creates a larger problem. Someone must confirm who controls the agent, how much it can spend, and whether the recipient is legally allowed to receive the payment. 

This becomes harder when stablecoins and other blockchain payments settle within seconds and generally cannot be reversed.

Sphere Labs is building SphereNet to handle that part of the process. On August 3, the company announced that Deutsche Telekom would operate a validator from the network's current testnet through its planned 2027 mainnet launch.

Checking the Rules Before Money Moves

Traditional financial institutions can investigate suspicious transactions after settlement. They may freeze an account, reverse a transfer, or attempt to recover the funds.

Instant blockchain settlement leaves far less time to intervene. SphereNet aims to move identity checks, sanctions screening, and jurisdictional rules directly into transaction execution. The payment reaches final settlement only after those conditions are met.

Consider an AI agent purchasing cloud storage for a company. SphereNet would need to identify the company behind the agent, confirm that the agent has permission to spend, screen the receiving business, and apply the rules governing both jurisdictions. The transfer could then settle without waiting for a manual review.

Google, Visa, and Mastercard are developing systems that help merchants recognize approved agents and confirm what users authorized them to do. SphereNet is working on the regulated settlement layer underneath those systems.

"Everyone debating agentic payments is debating the AI component," Sphere Labs CEO Arnold Lee said. "The true constraint is trust."

Deutsche Telekom's Enterprise Validator Experience

A validator runs the infrastructure that checks transactions and helps the network maintain one agreed financial record. For SphereNet, that means confirming that transactions have followed the network's rules before they become final.

Deutsche Telekom MMS already operates validator infrastructure for several established blockchain networks. SphereNet gives that experience a more specialized role: supporting a ledger designed for banks, payment companies and other regulated institutions.

content_html_zh:
让人工智能能够花钱——我们已经实现了吗？ 人工智能代理现在可以为企业预订航班、更新软件或购买计算能力。 下一步是允许该代理自行完成付款。

这种转变已经在进行中。 自 2025 年 5 月以来，Coinbase 的 x402 协议已处理 1.096 亿笔交易，调整后交易量约为 1500 万美元。

大多数都是小额支付，但如果规模更大，就会产生更大的问题。 必须有人确认谁控制着代理人、可以花多少钱，以及收款人是否合法地有权接收付款。

当稳定币和其他区块链支付在几秒钟内结算并且通常无法逆转时，这就变得更加困难。

Sphere Labs 正在构建 SphereNet 来处理该过程的这一部分。 8 月 3 日，该公司宣布德国电信将在计划于 2027 年推出主网之前从该网络当前的测试网运行验证器。

资金转移前检查规则

传统金融机构可以在结算后调查可疑交易。 他们可能会冻结账户、撤销转账或尝试追回资金。

即时区块链结算留下的干预时间要少得多。 SphereNet 旨在将身份检查、制裁筛查和管辖规则直接转移到交易执行中。 只有满足这些条件后，付款才能最终结算。

考虑一个人工智能代理为一家公司购买云存储。 SphereNet 需要识别代理背后的公司，确认代理有权支出，筛选接收业务，并应用管理两个司法管辖区的规则。 然后，无需等待人工审核即可完成转账。

谷歌、Visa 和万事达卡正在开发系统，帮助商家识别经过批准的代理商并确认用户授权他们做什么。 SphereNet 正在研究这些系统下的受监管结算层。

Sphere Labs 首席执行官阿诺德·李 (Arnold Lee) 表示：“每个争论代理支付的人都在争论人工智能组件。” “真正的约束是信任。”

德国电信的企业验证者体验

验证器运行检查交易并帮助网络维护一份商定的财务记录的基础设施。 对于 SphereNet 来说，这意味着在交易最终确定之前确认交易遵循网络规则。

德国电信 MMS 已经为多个已建立的区块链网络运行验证器基础设施。 SphereNet 赋予这种体验更专业的作用：支持为银行、支付公司和其他受监管机构设计的分类账。
